title: feat(nm2sreadt2z): neighbor-read of 1-in 2-out split freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition H
science: opposite seed, z-probes: the ONLY cell in the band where the unsigned neighbour-read HOLDs at all four probes, giving reverse=hold face=hold.
